title: About me
description: Jorge Parra is an Assistant Professor (2025) in the Electronics Department at the University of Valencia (UV). He received his PhD (2022, extraordinary prize), Master’s (2020), and Bachelor’s (2016) in Telecommunication Engineering from the Polytechnical University of Valencia (UPV).
